senses.gloss: A despised and mixed caste (Mar. Ḍoma).

__1 Riot, tumult, affray. 
__2 Petty warfare between villages. 
__3 Terrifying an enemy by shouts and gestures. 
-रम् Running away through fear, rout.

A sort of small drum shaped like an hour-glass and generally used by Kāpālikas; (sometime regarded as n. also); चण्डैर्डमरुनिर्घोषैर्घर्घरं श्रुतवान् ध्वनिम् [[Rāj. T. 2. 99.]] 
-Comp. 
-यन्त्रम् a kind of pan; [[Bhāva P.]]

€10U. (डम्बयति-ते) 
__1 To throw, send. 
__2 To order. 
__3 To behold.

a. Famous, renowned. 
-रः 
__1 An assemblage, collection, mass; [[Māl. 9. 16.]] 
__2 Show, pomp. 
__3 Resemblance, likeness, appearance; [[U. 6. 17]]; [[Māl. 3. 7.]] 
__4 Pride, arrogance. 
__5 A great noise, loud assertion, verbosity; आविर्भाबडम्बरं कृत्वा [[Ks. 107. 5.]] 
__6 Beauty. 
-Comp. 
-नामन् Having a high-sounding name; [[Māl. 1. 4-5.]] (v. l.)

a. 
__1 Terrific, dreadful, awful; पर्याप्तं मयि रमणीयडामरत्वं संधत्ते गगनतलप्रयाणबेगः [[Māl. 5. 3.]] 
__2 Riotous, tumultuous. 
__3 Resembling, having the appearance (i. e. lovely, beautiful); रतिगलिते ललिते कुसुमानि शिखण्डक- [Page0751-1] -डामरे (चिकुरे) [[Gīt. 12. 6.]] 
-रः 
__1 An uproar, rout, affray, riot. 
__2 The bustle and confusion of festivity or strife. 
__3 Any surprising sight. 
__4 N. of a mixed caste; [[Rāj. T.]]
